projects.title: Friday: Voice AI Assistant for Discord
projects.tech: Parakeet TDT 0.6B, Kokoro 82M, Silero VAD, n8n, Ollama, ONNX
points: Hands-free voice AI assistant that auto-joins your Discord voice channel, listens for speech, transcribes it, queries a local LLM agent, and speaks the response back — all without any commands.

points.title: Voice Pipeline
items: End-to-end pipeline: Discord voice → Silero VAD → Parakeet TDT 0.6B ASR → n8n webhook → Kokoro 82M TTS → Discord voice
Real-time voice activity detection with 1.5s silence timeout for natural turn-taking
Interrupt-on-speech: playback stops immediately if you talk while Friday is speaking

points.title: Local-first AI
items: Fully local LLM inference via Ollama (granite4:3b-h) — no cloud LLM dependency
All ASR and TTS models run on-device via ONNX (CPU for ASR/VAD, CUDA for TTS)
Google Search tool backed by Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite for real-time web lookups

points.title: n8n Agent Backend
items: Visual low-code agent workflow with three trigger paths: voice (ASR), Discord text messages, and hourly cron
Exposes a REST /speak endpoint so external systems can trigger voice output without speech input
Modular design — add new tools or integrations by dropping nodes into the n8n workflow

projects.title: UBAssist: RAG-powered University Chatbot
projects.tech: LLMs, RAG, Cursor, Hugging Face, Docker, FAISS, LoRA, QLoRA
points: An intelligent university assistant providing instant answers to student queries about courses, policies, and campus information.

points.title: Key Features
items: Fine-tuned Microsoft Phi 1.5 model with LoRA/QLoRA (48% faster training, 12% better accuracy)
18,000+ university documents with hybrid dense/sparse retrieval
30% fewer incorrect responses vs. standard RAG implementations
Real-time answers with conversational context

points.title: Technical Implementation
items: Production-ready deployment with Flask, FastAPI, and Docker
Efficient 13M parameter model with optimized architecture
FAISS vector database for fast semantic search
Deployed on Hugging Face Spaces for easy access

projects.title: Grayscale to RGB Image Colorization
projects.tech: CNN, UNet, Vision Transformers, GANs, Gradio
points: Transform black-and-white photos into vibrant color images using deep learning. Perfect for restoring old photographs or adding life to grayscale artwork.

points.title: Architecture & Performance
items: U-Net with Vision Transformer blocks and attention gates
Patch discriminator-based adversarial training (GAN)
94.15% structural similarity on 5,000 test images
Sub-second inference time for real-time results

points.title: Advanced Techniques
items: Weighted loss function for handling rare color classes
Patch-level GAN loss for photorealistic texture consistency
Learned complex color relationships for natural results

points.title: Try It Now
items: Interactive Gradio web app on Hugging Face Spaces
Upload any grayscale image and get instant colorization
No signup required - try it directly in your browser

projects.title: Phase Classification in Sleep Signals using CRNNs
projects.tech: Deep Learning, Inception, GRU, EEG Signal Processing
points: Automated EEG sleep phase classification system that identifies Cyclic Alternating Patterns (CAP) in sleep recordings, eliminating the need for manual expert analysis.

points.title: Architecture & Performance
items: Hybrid Inception-GRU architecture for temporal pattern recognition
74.64% accuracy with 83.4% A-phase sensitivity on 9,306 samples
Processes 2-second EEG windows at 512 Hz sampling rate
Trained on PhysioNet CAP Sleep Database with 16 subjects

points.title: Technical Features
items: Support for C4-A1 and C3-A2 EEG channels
Multiple validation strategies: hold-out and k-fold cross-validation
Balanced dataset construction for robust training
MATLAB preprocessing pipeline for signal conditioning
